crew.original_title: The Curious Case of Benjamin Button
crew.overview: Born under unusual circumstances, Benjamin Button springs into being as an elderly man in a New Orleans nursing home and ages in reverse. Twelve years after his birth, he meets Daisy, a child who flits in and out of his life as she grows up to be a dancer. Though he has all sorts of unusual adventures over the course of his life, it is his relationship with Daisy, and the hope that they will come together at the right time, that drives Benjamin forward.
crew.title: The Curious Case of Benjamin Button

details.biography:
Brent Joseph is an award-winning writer, director, and editor, born in New Orleans in 1974.

From tales of his Lebanese family working as peddlers in Louisiana’s Cajun communities to life in the aftermath of Hurricane Katrina, his directing work explores stories of people surviving—and often thriving—on the edges of society. His films have screened at festivals from Los Angeles to Paris, including Full Frame, Slamdance, the Austin Film Festival, and Rooftop Films.

As an editor, Brent began as an assistant in the cutting rooms of David Fincher, Larry Clark, and Seth Rogen, before going on to edit features and TV programs that aired on PBS and MTV, and screened at SXSW. Most recently, he edited "La Gloria," starring Emmy Award–winning actor David Morse. He has also edited films for Microsoft and cut trailers for "American Horror Story."
details.name: Brent Joseph
